Previous producer/report/count/adjudication bytes remain exact; only prior durability becomes historical. Book examples are rendered teaching. Necessary host tools are read-only; all project data remains repository-volume rooted and RGX/PGEN remain black boxes. Wrapper startup .7 owns establishment/liveness; recovery/purge stay prohibited and no lifecycle guarantee follows. Focused proof does not claim canonical CI; infrastructure/complete-family/push boundaries require it.
